title.en: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred and Fourteen of Act Numbered Four Hundred and Ninety-Six, Entitled "the Land Registration Act," as Amended, Fixing a New Schedule of Fees for Clerks of Courts and Registers of Deeds.

text.en:
Section one hundred and fourteen of Act Numbered Four hundred and ninety-six, entitled "The
Land Registration Act," as amended, is hereby further amended by inserting at the end thereof, the following
additional clause:
"Notwithstanding the rates hereinabove provided, in all other contracts where the actual value of the
encumbrance or real right sought to be registered is not fixed in the contract or cannot be determined from the
terms thereof, the basis for fixing the registration fees shall be the assessed value during the current year of the
property affected."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1926.
